title: Retained authored text after account deletion
claim: Retained records with a departing user's actor/resolver/owner reference could preserve the deleted account's direct identifiers in authored text.
classification: confirmed by current model and deletion-service review

owner_policy.general: Delete user data and retain security/audit logs.
owner_policy.shared_chat_exception: Retain household messages with an anonymized author and preserve message text.
owner_policy.shared_content: Retain approved public/system content with ownership removed; redact direct account identifiers and absolute local paths from retained non-chat text.

reviewed_retained_fields: game-related media title, creator, summary, and URLs
PC cheat label, payload, and notes
another member's game-request title and notes when the deleted account resolved it
another member's support-ticket title, body, metadata text, URLs, and logs when the deleted account resolved it
unmatched-folder feedback, notifications, duplicate-fix notes, system-event audit text, and household chat messages
implementation: Before deleting the user, retained authored/resolver text is scrubbed for exact case-insensitive name, email, and stable user ID matches plus absolute local paths. Actor/resolver references are cleared in the same transaction. Public/system collections remain ownerless. Household chat message bodies remain unchanged under the explicit exception.

verification.database_cleanup: disposable database dropped after the run

limits: Text is scrubbed when it exactly contains the account name, email, stable user ID, or a detected absolute path; other personal facts written in free text cannot be reliably inferred or removed.
This does not change the explicit household-chat text retention exception.
No deployed schema, operator data, or production restart was inspected.
